findings.detail: EN convoy casualties: 'A man is lying beside one of the vehicles ... A few paces from the first body, another man is down, farther ahead' describes TWO people; RU 'В нескольких шагах лежит второй. Дальше — ещё один' incorrectly adds a THIRD casualty. Remove the invented third person.
EN Mayfair boutique 'closed to the public afternoon' vs RU 'закрыли ... на весь день' incorrectly extends closure from afternoon to whole day. Preserve only the afternoon.

EN 'Caleb has spent the better part of his adult life being stared at by everyone' vs RU 'Калеб рассматривался всеми': passive bureaucratic calque breaks narrative style; change to natural Russian, maintaining being looked at.

EN Caleb 'You must think I’m a complete fucking mess' vs RU 'ты считаешь меня полным, блядь, бардаком': unnatural literal noun predicate; recast in idiomatic, emotionally vulnerable Russian while retaining profanity.
